BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉
5+ years of experience as a System Engineer or similar role
5+ years Network and Systems experience
3+ years Virtualization technology experience (Cisco, VMware, NetApp, Pure Storage and Netapp)
Preferably good understanding of other Virtualization technologies (Citrix, Hyper-V, Azure /Azure Stack and Citrix Terminal Services)
3+ years SAN, DR and Backup experience
Very good understanding and knowledge of networking and application-level operations
VMWare Certification highly desirable
Critical thinker and problem-solving skills
Team player
Good time-management skills
Great interpersonal and communication skills
Stay up to date with latest technology and best practices
We are looking for a Senior System Engineer with a focus on Virtualization and Storage solutions interested in joining an ongoing project for one of our clients., You will be a member of our core engineering team, and will have an opportunity to advance in your career., Provide operational and strategic direction for the Cloud Virtualisation & Storage environment, Working alongside the strategic Cloud vendors (Cisco UCS, VMware, Pure Storage, NetApp), Completing Cloud Service requests and incidents for customers, Resolution of Cloud Services issues, Management of the overall Virtualisation & Storage environment, Management and upkeep of Cloud Services infrastructure, Attractive salary package, Cool projects to work on
